poc_plan: Duration: 4 weeks (POC) — Dedicated pool + canary routing from production traffic
Week 0: VPC peering + IAM/KMS setup; NDA & security checklist complete
Canary plan: start at 2% traffic -> 5% after 48h -> 20% if SLOs met (p95 latency & error thresholds)
Model variants: primary: redwood-guardian-7B-quant (dedicated), fallback: redwood-guardian-7B-fp16 (hosted), degrade: redwood-lite-3B for burst
Routing policy: latency-first for interactive flows (p50 target 75ms, p95 target <=300ms), cost-aware routing for background tasks
Region failover: prefer us-west; failover to eu-west if us-west capacity constrained (geo rules + GDPR residency tags)
Rollback criteria: p95 latency > 300ms for 30m, error rate > 2% sustained for 15m, or regression on eval prompts > 5% F1/QA metric
Observability: token-level cost breakdown, per-route p95/p50, multivariate A/B telemetry (quality + latency), alerting on quality regressions
Success metrics: maintain p95 latency <=300ms, error rate <1%, no more than 2% quality regression vs baseline prompts, cost/unit within 20% of estimate
Deliverables: runbook for canary steps, dashboard links, final recommendation & sizing for Dedicated commit
requirements_summary: Workload: interactive support chatbot + document search; mix of short chat messages and 1-3k token summaries
Targets: p50 ~75ms, p95 <=300ms, throughput ~20 reqs/s sustained for peak route
Cost sensitivity: medium-high (team expects per-token cost below $0.0008 for embeddings and <$0.002 for gen in committed tier)
Model preference: open model variants preferred; willing to test Redwood-verified variants and quantized builds
Fallback/rollout needs: strict canary, automatic fallback to hosted model variants and cross-region failover
Security: SOC2 required, SSO for console, audit logs retention 90 days, KMS integration for keys, US + EU data residency
